notes.title: Typo fixes
notes.content:
Small patch that fixes some tiny typos in the depths of Endless Mode.

The notes, Endless Mode, reset function, and all achievements are working now. Enjoy torturing Noel! </3

(If you still can't get some achievements, I could think up of some more hints to get the hardest ones. I see no one has gotten the birthday one, and I'm really looking forward to seeing who's gonna crack that one first...)

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
- Added hints for the trickier achievements in Endless Mode. My hint is, you'll have to go beyond the game itself. Truly meta.
- Fixed a couple broken achievements (integers weren't being added correctly)
- You can now re-do a few specific scenes that give achievements from the main game in Endless Mode instead of having to start the game over.

This update also begins to fix the notes system with a new backend. Another update will come out soon that will hopefully 100% fix all of the issues related to it.


- Meiri

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Released a hotfix that fixes several issues with the Brazilian Portuguese translation.

Also disabled the possibility of a bug that only one person has ever found, but just in case it can happen again.... it's disabled.....

Someone save me.
